title: Unit Event — Step by Step!

meta.Outline: Minori has told her groupmates in MORE MORE JUMP! that she wants to switch to the credit-based course. This hasn't been an easy decision to make, but she's been supported by some special people.

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I've made up my mind...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'm going credit-based...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Minori...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That's because I gave this decision a lot of thought.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: A lot of thought...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Um, Minori?
Would you mind telling me more about what you did during that time?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah, I wanna hear too...
It'll be good for us to understand what your thought process was.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, sure...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: After I spoke to you and Haruka, Airi, I...
A few days earlier
Minori's Room

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Haruka said how going credit-based might lead to gaps forming between me and my friends...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (And Airi also experienced that.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: It makes sense...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: If I switch to the credit-based course and prioritize work, things could start getting awkward between me and my friends too.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We wouldn't be in class together as much, and the same goes for committee stuff.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I guess that's what Haruka meant when she said it's like switching to a completely different lifestyle...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And yeah, that might be kind of sad...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (But I have to be prepared to make some sacrifices if I want to do more as an idol.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (As we keep receiving offers, there's bound to be lots that I'll absolutely want to accept.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I can't have the luxury of being a full-time student while working as a full-time idol...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
...
Or can I have it both ways?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Do I really need to choose one or the other...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
What if I could find a way?
What if I worked really, really hard...? Would that make it possible...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
For example...
What if there was a way I could work more without going credit-based?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'll try coming up with something!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: If there really is a way for me to keep going to school and seeing my friends like normal, that'd be ideal...!
Several dozen minutes later

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
No, this one too!
I can't get any of my ideas to work!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I came up with so many methods...
Sprinting as fast as I can the moment classes end, leaving during lunch and coming back...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But shoots and meetings tend to be scheduled for when I'm supposed to be in class...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That makes sense, though... The people asking us to appear are also just working their normal hours during the week...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Which means there's no budging...
<Evening, Minori.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Len?!
But it's so late! What are you doing here?!
bgm_area00002

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<The thing is...
I got the sense that you were struggling with something.>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <I knew I had to help, so here I am.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
What?!
Wow, you're spot on!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Wait, hold on...
Len, are you some kind of psychic?!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Haha. It makes it a little hard to tell you the real reason if you take me seriously like that.>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <The truth is, I heard from Airi about what's going on. You're thinking about switching to the credit-based course, but aren't completely sure yet, right...?>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Airi told you...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Yeah. So, if there is something you wanna discuss, I'm here to help.>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <But listening is all I might be able to do since I don't know much about school and stuff...>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: No, I was just thinking I wanted somebody to hear me out, so it's really nice to hear you say that!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
You're right, Len.
This is about me switching to the credit-based course.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That's probably my best option in terms of being able to work more as an idol...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But Airi and Haruka said how gaps or rifts may form between me and my friends if I do, which would be sad...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I mean, I understand that I have to be willing to sacrifice certain things if I'm going to work more as an idol...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Right...>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But I really don't want to have to make that choice.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Which is why I was just putting together a schedule to see if I can still have it both ways!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Minori...>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Okay, now I see where you're at...>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <After talking with Airi, I was wondering what kind of a solution you'd try to come up with...>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <But I didn't imagine you were trying to find a way to be both a full-time student and idol. That sort of thinking does go along with your optimism, Minori...>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I-It does?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But I couldn't figure out a good way in the end.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <I see...>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Is there any way to reschedule those shoots and stuff?>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I did consider that...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But the last time someone rescheduled a meeting to the evening for us, the staff mentioned that it was outside of their regular hours...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I realized we were placing a burden on them. I really don't want to put anyone through that kind of trouble...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <I had no idea...>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Also, if that kind of thing continues...

rows.Speaker: Staff Person
rows.Line: So, it turns out that MORE MORE JUMP! is only going to be available when they don't have school. Their appearance on idol Hazard went pretty well too...

rows.Speaker: Important Person
rows.Line:
What?
Doesn't that mean they won't be able to be our on-site reporters for that shoot we discussed the other day?

rows.Speaker: Staff Person
rows.Line: That's correct, sir. They did however ask if we could reschedule to a later time...

rows.Speaker: Important Person
rows.Line: A later time? It's a special on trendy cafes for our female viewers, not hot dinner dates after dark!

rows.Speaker: Staff Person
rows.Line: Yes, of course. I'll have to reply by saying that it would change the feel of our program too much if we were to fulfill their request.

rows.Speaker: Important Person
rows.Line: I know that most of them have experience being idols, but it's still too soon for them to be asking us to reschedule like this. They can start throwing their weight around once they've become as popular as ASRUN used to be...

rows.Speaker: Important Person
rows.Line:
For now, stop sending them any offers.
In fact, blacklist them.

rows.Speaker: Staff Person
rows.Line: Understood! I'll also let the president know that we are to stop asking them to appear any further!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What if something like that happens?!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <I-Is that really possible?>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <But I do understand not wanting to cause your business partners any trouble. And it'd be terrible if they stopped making you offers because of something you did.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I know...
Which is why rescheduling is gonna be really tough.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But that also means having to choose between school and work. So, if I want to keep pursuing our dream, I should probably switch to the credit-based course...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But unlike Airi and the others, I don't think I'm clearly seeing all the pros and cons...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Then, let's try to get a clearer look!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Minori, you just said that you tried to come up with a schedule that lets you be a normal student while you work.>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <So, why not next try coming up with one for after you've switched to the credit-based course?>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <If you look at things from that perspective, you might start to see how much time you'll be spending at school versus how much you'll be working...>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <That could help you figure out the pros and cons of this system.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Th-That's genius...!
I should try that before jumping to any conclusions!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Okay, I'll give your idea a try.
This version can be called, Minori Hanasato: Full-Time Idol!
Minori's Room

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Uhh, okay...
If I wanted to focus on being an idol, based on our schedule for this coming month...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, we're mostly working in the afternoon...
Which means I'll only be at school in the morning...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Sounds like you'll be working a lot.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Photo shoots and stuff don't usually take more than a day, but TV takes much more time since we need to meet with the production staff a lot beforehand...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So, unless the scheduling lines up just right, I won't be able to go on the field trip or anything...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Minori...>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, but...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: If we went with this schedule, I'd get to do that interview with “LoVE IDoL”. I was so sure that was never going to happen.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <“LoVE IDoL”?>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, it's a website that I browse through pretty often with info on every idol you can think of! They publish news articles and even post all their interviews!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So, when we got an offer and I thought about us doing one of those interviews, it felt like something out of a dream...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But we couldn't accept the offer. Haruka and I are supposed to be at school on the day they suggested, and Shizuku and Airi already had other work scheduled.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Oh, that's too bad...>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But I would be able to do that interview if I followed this “full-time idol” schedule... If I were credit-based.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And looking at the schedule like this makes me realize just how much time I spend at school each day...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I mean, I guess that's normal since we're in high school and studying is supposed to be our priority!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Yeah, I didn't realize going credit-based would free up so much of your time...>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<I see another schedule over here...
What's this one for?>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, that's our current schedule that Airi made!
She put it together to help us accept as many offers as we can.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<I see...
It's packed from dawn until dusk. It's pretty incredible you're pulling this off...>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <But now I'm kinda worried about your health.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Right...
We discussed as a group that we need to take care of our health, but...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I think we're making Airi and Shizuku push themselves a bit since they're the ones working during the day while we're at school.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But going credit-based would free up a lot of my time and give me the flexibility to help them more, and we could accept more offers...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So, I...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I think I should go credit-based after all.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Minori...>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Our main goal right now is to get our name out there so that we'll be able to do a show at the Dome as MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So, we need to be able to accept as many offers as we can. And if me switching to the credit-based course will allow us to do that, then that's what I should do.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Right...>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: My plan is to ask my teacher about this tomorrow...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I have so many questions. I need to know how I can get the material from any classes I miss, how tests will work, all of that...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'll try making a decision after hearing what they have to say...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Okay...>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <I guess you're just the way you are, Minori.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Huh?
Is that a good thing or a bad thing?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh no! Look at the time!
I'm so sorry for keeping you this late, Len!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Don't mind me.
I'm just glad you seem to be feeling a little better, Minori.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hehe. That's because you helped, Len.
All the disorganized thoughts in my head came together thanks to you!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'll let you and the others know when I've come to a decision!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Thanks! I'll be looking forward to it!>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (I was going to tell Minori about what we discussed in SEKAI if she was worrying about her friends like Airi was...)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (But I see now that Minori's trying to find a way that she feels good about.)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (So, I should probably refrain from saying too much...)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (Good luck, Minori.)
The next day
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thank you very much for discussing this with me!

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line:
No, it was my pleasure.
Please feel free to drop by and ask more questions if you have any.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I'm so glad I talked to my teacher about going credit-based. I was given such a clear explanation...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (But it's gonna be hard to get my homework done and stuff...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I thought they'd have supplementary classes or something to make up for whatever I miss... But I just have to study on my own.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (That makes sense, though. Even if they had supplementary classes, I might not be able to make them because of work. Plus, it'd be way too hard on the teachers if they had to teach us all one-on-one...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Which means... Everyone who's credit-based studies in between work appointments and stuff...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(Tests don't just go away either.
I have to plan for all that myself...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Th-That sounds really hard. Airi and Shizuku have been doing this the whole time? That's amazing...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Haruka too. She went credit-based during junior high and only switched back to being a normal student recently...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (She even said that she hardly ever got to participate in things like the Sports Festival and School Festival...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (And if I go credit-based, I won't be able to either...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Minori? What are you mumbling about?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, Shiho, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You literally ran out of class after it ended. We were wondering where you went, but I guess you just needed to visit the teachers' office...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
That's a lot of papers you've got there...
Did they ask you to carry them or something?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, um... Th-These are...
se_event_step_2023_002

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh no!
M-My papers!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Geez, really...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
A-Are you okay?!
Here, I'll help pick these up for... Huh?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: “Switching to the Credit-Based Course”...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Uhh...
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Courtyard

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: So, Minori, you're thinking about switching to the credit-based course?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Y-Yeah...
But I haven't made my final decision yet...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Right... You and your group have become famous enough to start appearing on TV and radio programs together.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: True. I remember hearing from Shizuku when she first enrolled that this school's credit-based course gives her more flexibility to work...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
So, I think it's a good idea.
I mean, you want to keep pursuing your dream, right?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Shiho...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But it is a little sad to hear that...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: No, it's just... I know you worked really hard to become an idol, and are still working hard...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
So if this makes things easier for you...
If you think this is the right way to go, Minori, I want to give you my support...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But it also means seeing less of each other at school, and there'd be no chance of us being in the same class again.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That was actually kinda bothering me too...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Airi's currently credit-based, and Haruka was before... And they both said it was sad they didn't get to see their friends as much after switching...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I mean, it seems only natural not being able to see your friends as much since you're going to physically be at school less.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm not sure there's much you can do about that.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
At the same time, what do I know?
In the end, Minori, you have to make your own decision...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Still, if I were in your position, I'd probably choose the credit-based course.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yes, I wouldn't be able to see my friends as much, but we don't necessarily have to talk at school and stuff.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I may be busy working, but we could always set aside time to meet or hang out.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: And if going credit-based made it easier for me to make my dream come true, then I'd absolutely choose that option.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I agree...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: You do?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, um... I know I said that I'd be sad...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But placing myself in your shoes, Minori... I'd also probably want to switch if it was the best way to make my dream come true...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Kohane...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We might not be able to have lunch together or talk like this as much...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But your dream is to spread hope to as many people as you can as an idol... I really want that to happen.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Thank you both.
I'm really glad I talked to you about this...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I feel like I got some courage!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: That's good to hear.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And if I do end up switching to the credit-based course, I promise to still message you guys. Every single day...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: No, every single hour!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, that seems like a bit much.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Whaaat?!
Minori's Room

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Heh heh heh...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I ended up making some Print Stickers with Shiho and Kohane♪

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. I'll keep them in my phone case!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
And I couldn't be happier...
They said they'll support my decision, and that we'll be friends forever...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I feel the same way...
I won't get to see them at school as much, but I still wanna keep being friends.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So, I'm sure it'll be okay... As long as we feel that way about each other, we're not going to end up completely separated.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Alright...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That just leaves schoolwork.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Going credit-based means having to plan ahead and learn what I can from my textbooks. Plus, I won't really have time to ask my teachers any questions...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: How am I gonna handle all that...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: No, I can't let that get to me now.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I have to figure out a way.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Mom! Dad!
There's something I need to discuss with you guys.
Hanasato Household - Living Room

rows.Speaker: Minori's Mother
rows.Line: What's going on? Is something the matter?

rows.Speaker: Minori's Father
rows.Line: You said you'd like to discuss something with us. If this is about your allowance, you need to wait until the beginning of your second year...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: No, it's not about that.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Y-Yes, I do wanna discuss my allowance later, but this is much more important...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I want to switch to the credit-based course.

rows.Speaker: Minori's Mother
rows.Line: The credit-based course...?

rows.Speaker: Minori's Mother
rows.Line:
Oh, now I remember...
Aren't Airi and Shizuku also in that?

rows.Speaker: Minori's Father
rows.Line: Which means... Minori, are you hoping to switch in order to contribute more as a member of MORE MORE JUMP!?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Our solo show and the TV appearance the other day went so well that all these people are asking us to work with them.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But most of them need us to be available during the day. So far, we've had to turn down some of them because I'm in school during that time...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Which has been bothering me a lot lately. I'm afraid of what's gonna happen if this keeps up...

rows.Speaker: Minori's Mother
rows.Line: Yes, you did mention you've had to turn down some offers that you were really hoping to accept...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Exactly. Our main goal right now is to do a show at the Dome and spread more hope than we ever have.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Which means we need to get our name out there by working as much as we can as a group.

rows.Speaker: Minori's Father
rows.Line: I understand what you're saying, Minori...

rows.Speaker: Minori's Father
rows.Line:
However, we can't agree to this lightly.
Switching to the credit-based course doesn't simply equate to being able to use your time freely, right?

rows.Speaker: Minori's Father
rows.Line: How you handle your schoolwork and what sort of support your school is going to give you may change.

rows.Speaker: Minori's Father
rows.Line: You still need to study. Not only that, the onus will likely be placed solely on you to figure out a way to keep up with your peers somehow.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I know...

rows.Speaker: Minori's Father
rows.Line: Also, Minori... I'm sure you already realize that you won't be able to see your friends as much moving forward.

rows.Speaker: Minori's Father
rows.Line: By placing your work as an idol first, there's a strong possibility that you won't be able to participate in the Sports Festival, School Festival or other such events.

rows.Speaker: Minori's Father
rows.Line: In other words, you'll be relinquishing your only opportunity in life to enjoy high school like everyone else...

rows.Speaker: Minori's Father
rows.Line: With all of that in mind, are you prepared to make this switch?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (It hasn't even been a year since I entered high school, but so much has happened in that time...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I got to meet Shiho and Kohane because I was living life as a normal high schooler. On top of that...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (The Seaside School, the School Festival, everything... I had so much fun. And I was able to take part because I was a regular high school student...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (But I might not be able to moving forward after I switch to the credit-based course.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (However...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I've already made my decision.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I've given this a lot of thought.
School, my friends, homework, all of it...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I understand that things are going to get really tough from here on out. I'm sad about not being able to see my friends as much, and having to study all on my own is going to be tough too.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Still, with all of that in mind, I still want to do more as a member of MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Which is why I want to go credit-based...
I want to do everything I possibly can as an idol!

rows.Speaker: Minori's Mother
rows.Line: Minori...

rows.Speaker: Minori's Father
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Minori's Father
rows.Line: If you've already given it that much thought, then I have nothing else to say.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Dad...

rows.Speaker: Minori's Mother
rows.Line: Me neither...

rows.Speaker: Minori's Mother
rows.Line: When you first set out to become an idol, I was worried about whether it was really possible.

rows.Speaker: Minori's Mother
rows.Line: But you kept auditioning over and over again without ever giving up. Now, you have a wonderful group of friends, and successfully put on a solo show with them. You've become an idol like you always dreamed...

rows.Speaker: Minori's Mother
rows.Line: We couldn't be more proud of your achievements. So...

rows.Speaker: Minori's Mother
rows.Line: We want to see where your dream takes you, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Mom...

rows.Speaker: Minori's Mother
rows.Line:
Go credit-based. Follow your heart.
You have our support no matter what.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
Thank you so much!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I promise to become an idol who can spread hope to lots and lots of people... The best idol ever!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So, thank you...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thank you for your continued support!
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: ...which is how I made the decision to go credit-based.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You really thought about what we said that much?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Now I feel kinda bad. I really just said that sort of in passing...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And it sounds like you didn't need my help finding an answer that you're happy with.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: No, what you said just now feels like a huge source of encouragement!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Just now...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: The bonds you've forged with your friends won't easily break. The connections you've established with them will endure...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It may not seem that way at times moving forward...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But I don't want you to give up on them. You can always reset things by telling each other exactly how you feel.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: “The bonds you've forged with your friends won't easily break.”

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I want to believe that too!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Minori...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Which means...
We're all going to be credit-based, yes?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Yeah.
So...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We can start accepting those offers we initially couldn't.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Especially since we turned down some that we desperately wanted to do!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, while we're on the subject...
I tried coming up with a schedule to help myself imagine being in the credit-based course...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Take a look!
If Haruka and I are both credit-based, we'll be free during these hours.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Which means that one offer we thought we'd have to turn down would actually be—

Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: So, Minori, you and Haruka are ready to switch to the credit-based course?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yup!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I wasn't really sure at first...
But after giving it a lot of thought, I made a decision that I feel happy with!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. That's wonderful to hear.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: When you and I talked, you said schoolwork might be a challenge... Does this mean you know what you're gonna do about that?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, um... Not exactly since I won't know how a lot of things go until I actually give it a try...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But I've just gotta do the best I can!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Also, Airi, Shizuku, I can always ask you two if I have any questions since you've both been in it for so long now.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. Ask us whenever you like♪

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, we'll be more than happy to help if we can.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: The four of us will probably be studying together during our time off, which I'm actually sort of looking forward to...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, me too!!!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Wait, then!
We can stream that! What do you think?! We can call it something like “Let's Study with MORE MORE JUMP!”

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'd rather not. It'd be way too hard to focus.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. In any case, it's nice to hear that you're all looking forward to being in the credit-based course.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yeah!
By the way, when do you plan on making the switch...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Really soon!
I asked my teacher about it and was told that there are two opportunities per year to switch. Once in spring and once in the fall.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Which works out really well since we're all about to move up a year.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I see...
Oh, that means you get to be regular students until you begin your second year!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah, but it's still happening pretty soon.
That's why I want to treasure the time I have left.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I don't wanna find myself looking back after making the switch and saying, “No, I should've done that back then!”

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: That's understandable...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Okay, you two!
That means you really gotta have fun during the time you have left as regular high schoolers!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thanks, we will!

Hanasato Household - Living Room

rows.Line: Okay, I'm gonna get going now!!!

rows.Speaker: Minori's Mother
rows.Line: She did say something about trying to enjoy the time she has left as a regular high school student.

rows.Speaker: Minori's Brother
rows.Line:
Uh, okay...?

Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Wow, this breeze feels so nice!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh!
This flower is finally blooming!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Hehe. I was wondering when it would after seeing it budding just the other day...)

rows.Line: I have a really good feeling about today.

Good morning, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh! Morning, you two!

rows.Line:

rows.Line:
Oh, really?

rows.Line:

rows.Line:
No, that'd be awful!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Once it blooms, we can see it...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Oh, right...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I get to see these flowers with Shiho and Kohane because we go to school at the same time.)

rows.Speaker: Minori

rows.Line: Hey, did you guys see that sweets special yesterday?! The cafe they showed is apparently really close by.

rows.Speaker: Miya Girls Students
rows.Line: I heard an old alumnus is coming to visit our club today! I hope they're not too hard on us this time...

rows.Speaker: Miya Girls Students
rows.Line:
No, I totally forgot about that assignment!
Can you show me what you did?! Please, I'll never ask for anything again...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Everyone chatting with each other while we all head to school... I won't get to see that as much moving forward...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I never really thought of things this way before. It was all just “normal”...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Minori...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (The little things in life that happen every day. I guess I took it all for granted until now.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Then, I've gotta do my best to see everything else I've been taking for granted.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (That way, after I do go credit-based, I'll be able to look back fondly on all the fun stuff I did!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Minori Hanasato is still a regular high schooler! And she's gonna make the final sprint to reach the next chapter of her life! “Part 2: Full-Time Idol!”

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What are you talking about...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Minori sounds really excited.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Yes, she does. Still...>

rows.Line: <I wasn't expecting you to suggest seeing what her school's like, Len.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<Me neither...
What made you want to do this all of a sudden?>

rows.Line: <It wasn't as sudden as you think. I began wondering after Airi told us her story the other day.>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <I wasn't able to give her any useful advice then since I didn't really know anything about what it's like to go to school or be a student. It wasn't a good feeling...>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <So, I wanna learn more about their school.>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <That makes sense...>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <They ended up figuring everything out all on their own before I could do anything...>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <But school means a lot to them, so I wanna know what it's like to be a student.>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Right...>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <They always enjoy talking about things that happen at school and their friends there, but we've never actually seen that for ourselves...>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Learning about their school life could very well help us give them better advice if anything else comes up in the future.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <True...>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Then, let's go see what Minori is like as a student and what her school is like!>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Hehe. We'll need to make sure she doesn't see us.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <I'm not sure how I feel about us sneaking around like this... But I wouldn't want to ruin what precious little time she has left with her friends.>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Me neither. I wouldn't want to say something and make Minori concern herself with us.>

rows.Line: <So, everyone, shush! We gotta keep our voices down!>

rows.Line:

rows.Line: H-Hanasato...?!

rows.Line:

rows.Line:

rows.Line: It's too bad that you got that problem spectacularly wrong.

rows.Line:

rows.Line:
I mean, what's going on?
Why were you acting like an honor student today?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I was just...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: You know how I was thinking about going credit-based? I've made my decision already...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, so...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah...
Haruka and I are gonna be credit-based when we begin our second year.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So, because I don't have much time left as a regular student, I wanna make the most of each day!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: After I go credit-based, we probably won't get to take classes, study or clean together as much as before...

rows.Line:

rows.Line: What?! That's so mean! I was just trying to give today my all!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Line:

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Shiho and I were wondering what you'd do, but I'm glad you seem happy with your decision.

rows.Line:

rows.Line: Hehe. Thanks!

rows.Line:

rows.Line: Oh, you have work today...?

rows.Line: But if you plan on working full-time as an idol, doesn't that mean...?

rows.Line:

rows.Line: I see...

rows.Line:

rows.Line: Okay, see you.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
That's so great.
Minori's going straight after her dream.

rows.Line:

rows.Line:

rows.Line: She and Minori might be on the same shift.

rows.Line:

rows.Line:

rows.Line: What if she's planning on being an “active participant” at work and not just school...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: U-Umm...

rows.Line: The thing is...

rows.Line:
I didn't know that...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:

I'm really gonna miss her. We had so much fun working together.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I know how you feel...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But it's so cool that she's pursuing her dream like that! I'm a little sad right now, but I wanna give her all the support I can!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Still...
I guess we're not gonna be able to hang out as much as we have been...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait, I know!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Shiho, Kohane, do either of you have plans after this?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Well, Kohane and I were just thinking about getting something to eat since we don't have practice today...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, perfect!

rows.Line: Surprise?

rows.Line:
Heh heh heh.

rows.Line:
Hello?!
Hehehe. I need to ask you for a favor...

rows.Speaker: Shiho

rows.Line: So, I was hoping that we could have one last party to remember before you make the switch!

rows.Line: But this was sort of the only day that we could get to work because we all have practice and stuff.

rows.Line:

rows.Line: Haruka...

rows.Line: Up first, we have...

rows.Line:

rows.Line: Then, let's all get different ones and share them with each other! That way, we'll all get to try a bunch!

rows.Line:

rows.Line:

rows.Line:

rows.Line:

rows.Line:

rows.Line: It feels like I just spent a three-day weekend hanging out with you guys.

rows.Line: It does... I haven't had many chances to hang out like this lately, so it felt like a nice escape from things.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I agree...
Our solo show kept us busy for a while too.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, it did!
I'm glad we got to take a break and just have fun for a change♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
What do you think, Minori, Haruka?
Did you both have fun today...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Of course, we'll always remember today.
Right, Minori?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I really, really appreciate you all gathering like this, and...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'm truly grateful to have friends like you who give us so much support...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Minori...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
So, for me...
Just having met you all is the greatest of memories...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I couldn't have asked for better friends.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Th...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Thank goodness!
We did it, Ichi, Shiho, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, I guess it was worth doing this today.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thank you so much for putting this party together in such a hurry! It was really, reeaally fun!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Which is also why...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Having to say goodbye for today is a little tough...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, no...
It's not over yet.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. We still have another surprise for you both!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Another surprise?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah.
We went and got you presents before my shift!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Here, it's these.
Matching ballpoint pens for the both of you.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
They're nice ones from a nice brand!
And they feel really nice to write with!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You could be a little more descriptive, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We weren't sure what to get you two at first, but we thought something practical that you can use while you work would be best...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
So...
You're always writing up stream proposals and scripts, right? We thought you could use these to make your edits.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Shizuku even told me one time how it's always nice to have a multicolor pen on hand.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: You all put that much thought into these...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, I know this might make it feel like a chapter of your life is coming to a close... But again, this isn't goodbye.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What she said! We all wanna be friends forever and ever!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: You guys...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Getting your homework done and stuff's gonna be pretty hard, so don't be afraid to ask for help if you think you need it.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: If we're going to be ready to help them whenever, we'll need to take really good notes during class.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: *Gasp*

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thank you so much!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh?! Minori...?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thank you! Thank you! Thank you sooo much! You're all the best!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I don't think... I'll ever, ever forget this day.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'm gonna treasure the time we spent together today! Forever!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Minori...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Alright, settle down...
Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hehehe...
I can't believe how much fun we had, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Me neither. I really wasn't expecting them to throw us such a wonderful surprise party.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I know, right?!
I made the decision to make the most of each day, but this very first one ended up becoming totally unforgettable!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Even after we go credit-based, we can look back and...
<Minori! Haruka!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Huh?
That voice...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Evening, you two.>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: What brings you all here?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<So, the thing is...
We spent the entire day seeing what your school life is like, Minori!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What?! You did?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <You all care deeply about making the most of your life as high school students, so we wanted to see what that's actually like.>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Especially since I wished that I could help Airi more when she asked us for advice the other day.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<We apologize for not telling you.
We just really wanted a good insight into what you're like as students.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
No, that's totally fine!
Actually, your timing couldn't have been better!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I did a ton of things today as a part of making the most of the time I have left as a regular student!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, but... I got a problem wrong after raising my hand during class... I hope you guys didn't see that...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Hehe. Yes, we saw that as well.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <You seem to really enjoy your school life, and it was so dazzling to see... So much so that I wish I could also be a student!>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <But you won't be able to do the kind of things you did today so much after you go credit-based, right...?>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<Yes...
I'm beginning to see why this was such a tough decision...>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Still, I think you made the right choice...>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <I've been wanting to see what your friends are like since you've been telling us so much about them. And how much they mean to you.>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <After finally getting to see them for ourselves today, Minori, Haruka...>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <It's clear that they all feel the same way about the both of you.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Len...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <So, I think you'll be okay. You all care deeply about each other, and those feelings will keep you together.>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<And it's like what KAITO said.
The bonds you've forged won't break that easily.>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <You'll all be friends regardless of where life takes you.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: You're right...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We all had a ton of fun together today, and they even gave us these really thoughtful gifts.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'm so glad that I became friends with them, and I really believe now that we're gonna be friends forever.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Minori...>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
So, I agree... I think we made the right decision.
It was only for one short year, but... I had so much fun during my time as a regular high schooler.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And that's why these memories will help me move forward. Towards our dream...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'm gonna work as hard as I can so more and more and mooore people start following MORE MORE JUMP! And someday...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I wanna be able to spread hope to all of the friends who supported me along the way.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Minori...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay, that was a little embarrassing to say out loud...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<No, Minori...
I believe you can do it.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: R-Really...?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <I agree. I mean, Minori, you know just how important it is for an idol to walk this journey with their fans.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<And it's not just you...
Haruka, Airi, Shizuku...>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Each member of MORE MORE JUMP! has worked tirelessly to establish connections with all of your fans.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Which is much more difficult than you may realize, because both parties need to feel the same way about one another.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Luka...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <In that sense, it's like the bonds you've forged with your friends...>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <You should be able to keep making real connections with any number of people moving forward.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <And spread hope to them.>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: KAITO...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <With you and Haruka switching to the credit-based course, your group as a whole will be able to do considerably more as idols...>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <You'll get to work more, and all sorts of people will see what you're doing. In and of itself, that should be fun... But you'll also likely be faced with more challenges along the way.>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Those are the times when I hope you'll be reminded of what you feel is most important.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What we feel is most important...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Oh, I know what she's talking about!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<You just said it, Minori.
How you wanna spread hope to everyone!>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Yes, that does seem to be the motto of MORE MORE JUMP! at this point. The compass that always guides you girls...>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Precisely. And you've all gotten this far because of that feeling in your hearts.>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <So, as long as you don't forget that, I think you'll all do just fine.>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <I firmly believe that.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: MEIKO...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (She's right...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (My lifestyle's gonna change pretty drastically, and I'll start realizing things that I never would've before...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (It probably won't always be smooth sailing, and things might feel really hard at times.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thank you all so much.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I also believe we'll be able to handle whatever's thrown at us.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Minori...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, um... O-Of course, I know things won't always go smoothly, and I'm a little afraid of having to deal with tough problems...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
But like MEIKO said...
I have the desire in my heart to spread hope.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
And we all have each other.
That's what makes us MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We've had to deal with lots and lots of things until now... But we overcame all of those obstacles together.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
That includes you guys, Miku.
You were all there every step of the way.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Us too...?>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hehe...
It's a little embarrassing for me to say, but this felt like the right time...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thank you all very much for always being there for us.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That includes wanting to know what we're like as students. I really appreciate how kind and thoughtful you all are...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Minori...>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: She's right. You and the others are always happy to listen to our concerns and give us advice, Miku.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I can't thank you enough for giving us that kind of support...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Exactly!
There's no way we would've been able to come this far without you guys.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: In that sense...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: You guys are just as much a part of MORE MORE JUMP! as we are!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Wait, uh oh...
Was I out of line?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Not at all...>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
<Yes, we couldn't be happier!
We promise to cherish what you just said.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thank goodness!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I know that you and the others are always rooting for us and have our best interests in mind, Miku...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: No matter what happens, I'm gonna keep trying my best...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I wanna make the most of the support you guys give us.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So that we can keep spreading hope to more and more and more people!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Yeah...!>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <We're really looking forward to that!>
